checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Body is clearly blue, though a medium/cobalt blue, a bit brighter than true navy.

must.item: Car retains shape, position, windows, tyres, trim, lights
must.why: Geometry, windows, wheels, red tail light and plate look identical.

must.item: Shading and reflections consistent with sunny lighting
must.why: Highlights on roof and side panel and the shadow gradients carry over naturally.
Background looks the same; the distant red car is still red, which is acceptable.

faults.what: Blue is a brighter mid/cobalt blue rather than a deep navy.
Slight blue cast on the tail light edge/trim areas is barely noticeable; no real artefacts.

summary: The car was recoloured cleanly to blue with everything else intact, but the shade is brighter than true navy.
